subject: general
question: Which of the following universities designed and built the first electronic computer (ENIAC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**University of Pennsylvania**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first electrical, programmable, general-purpose computer **was called **ENIAC**.
 
• In **1945**, it was **completed**.
 
• There were **other computers **that had **similar features**, but **the ENIAC **had all of **them in one package.**
 
• It could solve **"a vast class of numerical problems" **through **reprogramming and was Turing-complete**.
 
• **ENIAC **was **conceptualized **by **J. Presper Eckert **and **John Mauchly**.
 
• To build the **ENIAC**, **roughly 17,500 vacuum tubes**, **7,200 diodes, **and **miles of cable were utilised**.
 
• The end **result was ENIAC **(Electronic Numerical Integrator And Computer), which was **constructed between 1943 and 1945 **and was the **first large-scale computer **to operate entirely at **electronic speed**.
 
• The **first electronic computer **was **developed **and constructed at **the University of Pennsylvania (ENIAC).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **University of Pennsylvania **is **a private Ivy League research university **in **Philadelphia, Pennsylvania**.
 
• It was **Established in 1740**.
 
• It is the **fourth-oldest institution **of **higher education **in the **United States **and among the **highest-ranked universities **in the **world**.
